newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES MUST BREAK 1650, OTHERWISE HEADING DOWN.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES MUST BREAK 1650, OTHERWISE HEADING DOWN.

text.p: Greek shares need to break resistance at 1,650 points with convincingly strong volume but failure to do so will lead the benchmark share index lower to 1,565 points, said Commercial Securities in a technical analysis outlook.

"An approach of 1,640 points on moderate volume will confirm the market's weakness and signal the start of a downward wave wchich could take the market below 1,565 points," Commercial's technical analyst Nick Kostopoulos said.
The 1,450-1,500 level was a strong support level, it said.

Only in case of a fast breakout beyond 1,650 on rising volume will this technical outlook be revised. The medium-term technical indicators which gave sell signals at the level of 1,700 points were still valid, he said.

The Athens general share index traded between 1,659-1,628 on Thursday on volume of 30 billion drachmas. The year high, also an all-time high recorded May 27, is 1,755.66 points. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
